title: Cost of Living Calculator: Compare Countries Accurately
seo_title: Cost of Living Calculator: Compare Countries Accurately
meta_description: Use a cost of living calculator to compare countries and cities fairly. Learn which assumptions to fix, what indices miss and how to build a real budget.
excerpt: A calculator can shortlist destinations, but it cannot build your relocation budget alone. Learn how to compare the same household, verify the largest costs and add the expenses indices miss.
